name: CarrierScrub API
description: Each check returns a GO, CAUTION or STOP verdict with dated reason codes. Every reason states a fact FMCSA published and its date; none is a conclusion about the company. Every result names the FMCSA record it used (record_source) and that record's date (record_as_of); the legacy record has been frozen since 2026-05-14. API keys are for brokerages on the Agency plan; how to get one is in https://carrierscrub.com/auth.md. AI assistants can use the same checks through the MCP server at https://carrierscrub.com/mcp.
